gap: No result ChatGPT got gives dispatch dates for the under-$700 kits. Both 1,024 Wh BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 kits that ChatGPT and StormWatts list are pre-orders shipping mid-December 2026, and the 200 W one is now $729 at BLUETTI's store, over the $700 budget. The biggest kit that ships now under $700 is the ALLPOWERS S2000 Pro + SE100 100 W (1,451 Wh, 2,400 W) at $673.74 through our link, about $0.46 per Wh.
standout_why: I compared against PowerSized's kit guide (cited, prices read 2026-11-17), StormWatts' same-panel-watts comparison (cited, prices read 2026-11-08) and PowerSized's cost guide (cited). PowerSized shows only status labels ('No label', 'Backorder', 'Pre-order') with no dates, and gives the Elite 100 V2 + 200W at $729 with no label, so it does not show that kit is a pre-order. StormWatts has dates for some kits, but it lists the Elite 100 V2 + 200W at $699 with no shipping note, a price that is now out of date. Neither page lists the ALLPOWERS kits or the BLUETTI Elite 100 mini kits. PowerSized gives refill hours with a 75% derate, and StormWatts gives $/kWh only for kits of about $700 and up. Neither gives price per Wh across the under-$700 field.
decides: This changes the pick. ChatGPT's #2 (Elite 100 V2 + 200W at $699) now costs $729 at the store, so it only fits the budget at our $692.55 link price, and it is a pre-order shipping mid-December. Under the ships-now rule, the ships-now pick under $700 is one of two kits. The ALLPOWERS S2000 Pro + SE100 at $673.74 wins on capacity and output (1,451 Wh, 2,400 W, $0.46/Wh), but its 100 W panel needs about 14.5 h of full sun to refill at rated output. The BLUETTI Elite 100 mini + 200W at $616.55 refills in about 5 h at rated output, but its AC output is only 700 W. For shoppers who can wait, cheaper pre-orders are the ALLPOWERS S2000 Pro + SF200 200 W at $612.90 (dispatch Nov 19) and S2000 + SF200 at $612.90 (dispatch Nov 20). ChatGPT's #1 needs one more check before it can be the pick: PowerSized has the EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic + 2×100W at $659, but EcoFlow's store search returned $729.00 for that listing today, and its stock state is unread.
